rows.title: Rename the colour “clay” to “due” in the tokens?
Social card for the launch: photo or illustration?
Promote the replica in a failover drill on Friday?
TestFlight: build 418 is out to 1,240 testers
Keep the CDC sync on its old schedule?
Search: a hosted service or an index built at deploy?
Postgres primary disk at 91%: add 200 GB now?
rows.words: The backfill for the dashboard wrote 140 GB of WAL today. Growing the disk takes no downtime.

rows.title: Which icon style for the tab bar?
rows.words: All three are drawn for the four tabs. The rest of the set follows the one you pick.

rows.title: Landing page: 1.4 s on a mid-range phone over 4G
rows.words: Was 3.1 s. The plant library now loads on the first keystroke in search.

rows.title: Done: onboarding in three steps is on staging
rows.words: Name, first plant, reminder time. 48 seconds on average in the hallway test.

rows.title: Load test: checkout holds 400 requests a second
rows.words: p95 under 180 ms up to 400 rps; at 520 rps the database pool runs out.

rows.title: API p95 latency down to 138 ms after the Postgres upgrade
rows.words: Was 210 ms. The 13:40 spike was the backfill job, not users.

rows.title: Cloud bill: €2,380 a month less from December
rows.words: Reserved instances, one NAT per region, plant photos through the CDN.

rows.title: Dark mode: keep the plant photos at full colour?
rows.words: Dimming them a little is calmer at night; full colour looks better.

rows.title: Generate the API reference from the OpenAPI file?
rows.words: Always matches the code. The examples are written by hand next to it.

rows.title: Which screenshots go first in the App Store?
rows.words: Pick up to three. The first one is the one people see in search.

rows.title: Show prices with VAT included everywhere?
rows.words: Required in the EU. In the US prices are usually shown without tax.

rows.title: Small or medium widget first?
rows.words: Both are designed; there is time to build one well before Friday.

rows.title: Which invoice details can people change themselves?
rows.words: Tick everything they may change in Settings. The rest goes through support.

rows.title: Ask for notifications on step 3, or after the first watering?
rows.words: On step 3 more people say yes; after the first watering they know why we ask.

rows.title: Upgrade production to Kubernetes 1.33 on Wednesday night?
rows.words: Staging runs 1.33 since Tuesday without a problem. Nodes roll one at a time.

rows.title: Docs layout: a sidebar, or tabs on top?
rows.words: The sidebar shows every page; tabs keep guides and the API apart.

rows.title: Send a weekly summary e-mail on Sundays?
rows.words: Which plants did well, which are due next week. People asked for it in the beta.

rows.title: How long do we keep the raw events?
rows.words: The models need 90 days. Longer costs storage and means more personal data kept.

rows.title: What should the sign-up button say?
rows.words: “Start free” is short and known. “Add your first plant” says what happens next.

rows.title: Who counts as an active user?
rows.words: Opening the app, or watering a plant. Watering is what we care about; opening is what others report.

rows.title: Which hero for the landing page?
rows.words: Same words, two layouts. The split one shows the app on a phone right away.

rows.title: Hold 1.2 for the widget crash fix in build 419?
rows.words: 12 crashes in 9 days, all in the widget timeline. 419 is built and on TestFlight since noon.

rows.title: Checkout: a sheet over the app, or its own page?
rows.words: Both are built with Stripe Elements. The sheet keeps people where they were.

rows.title: Launch on Monday at 09:00, or on Tuesday?
rows.words: Everything for Monday is green except the Safari test. Tuesday gives one more day for the App Store review.

rows.title: Apply the us-east plan? 23 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy
rows.words: The one destroyed is the second NAT gateway in eu-west, which we planned to drop.

rows.title: Skip the flaky Safari checkout test until after the launch?
rows.words: It fails 1 run in 6, only in WebKit, only on the payment iframe. The flow works by hand.

rows.title: Which colour palette for the launch?
rows.words: Three palettes, each tried on the Today screen. One goes into the tokens for web and iOS.

rows.title: Which drawing welcomes new people?
rows.words: The first screen of sign-up gets one illustration. Both are drawn and ready.

rows.title: Which headline for the launch?
rows.words: Two lines for the landing page, the App Store and the launch post.
